build_LatentPredictHead: build a LatentPredictHead with a loss config and predictor neck for BYOL or SimSiam self-supervised learning
create_LatentPredictHead_loss: create a LatentPredictHead loss computation by passing input and target feature tensors to the loss method
build_LatentCrossCorrelationHead: build a LatentCrossCorrelationHead with input channels and loss config for Barlow Twins cross-correlation self-supervised learning
create_LatentCrossCorrelationHead_loss: create a LatentCrossCorrelationHead loss by computing the cross-correlation matrix between input and target feature tensors
review_LatentPredictHead_predictor: review the LatentPredictHead predictor forward pass that applies a registered neck module to input features
